assets.title: Lab 04 interior and living ceiling
assets.pipeline_requested: Higgsfield Environment Concept / Wide Establishing Shot
assets.prompt: Interior of Lab 04, a refurbished industrial underwater benthic research station 15 meters below the Detroit River. Rusted steel bulkheads reinforced with bolted patch plates, tangled yellow ROV umbilical cables, analog pressure manifold gauges glowing dimly, and a humming air-scrubber unit. Through a massive reinforced acrylic ceiling dome and angled observation viewports, murky emerald-green freshwater stretches upward toward the surface—silhouetting dozens of eerie, motionless floating zombie corpses drifting in the river current like a dark living ceiling blocking the overcast sky. Volumetric god-rays of pale diffused sunlight pierce between the floating silhouettes, casting caustic water ripples across the metallic lab floor. Stylized-realistic 3D game environment, atmospheric fog, Unreal Engine 5 Lumen global illumination.
assets.negative_prompt: clear tropical blue ocean, coral reef, tropical fish, clean sterile sci-fi spaceship, bright neon cyberpunk colors, gore close-ups, dry land.

assets.title: Lab 04 exterior and river topography
assets.camera: Slow Crane Down + Underwater Current Drift
assets.prompt: Underwater wide establishing shot 15 meters beneath the Detroit River. Lab 04 sits anchored to the silty riverbed beside the rusted hull of a sunken Great Lakes freighter, tethered by thick insulated power cables rising toward the surface. Warm amber interior lights glow from Lab 04's reinforced portholes into the dark green, sediment-heavy river water. A small yellow autonomous inspection ROV with twin LED spotlights hovers near an intake valve clearing debris. In the murky upper water column near the surface, faint silhouettes of drifting corpses and a camouflaged diesel-pump buoy sway in the current. Suspended silt particles, volumetric underwater lighting, stylized-realistic 3D animation.
assets.negative_prompt: tropical ocean, sharks, whales, crystal clear water, bright sunshine, cartoon textures.
